catalog.note: A representative closed proof does not prepare the production catalog or authorize another original claim.

blockers: Production catalog contains specialized native families without a confined execution recipe.
The representative proof does not prepare every production Offline family.
Production activation requires the user's separate reviewed switch decision and current real owner/process reconciliation.
limitations: Read-only preparation preserves original claims, results, observations and legacy inputs; production remains unchanged.
No production installation or policy is prepared. Zero policy digests are explicit unavailable-policy sentinels, never acceptance seals.
Representative proof authenticates only its original isolated scope. Production activation requires separate reviewed approval and current authority.
